notes.title: Tower Defense Fest Sale & Behind The Scenes Stuff
notes.notes:
Coastal Defense is participating in the Tower Defense Fest with a [b]50%[/b] sale! 

With the event going on, I thought I'd post some behind the scenes stuff I've made while making the game. I'll also share some of the art along with the original reference pictures!

Click on the images to make them bigger!

All of the equipment in the game is or has been used by the Finnish Defense Forces (Puolustusvoimat). Some of the older stuff has been museumized, and you can come see them in Finland!
